# Storyblocks

> > Storyblocks provides unlimited royalty-free stock media including audio, video, and images with integrations for Adobe Creative Cloud, After Effects, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and Apple Motion.

Storyblocks offers curated collections of stock audio, music, and sound effects for creative professionals. The platform features the Storyblocks AI Toolkit and API for seamless workflow integration, with enterprise-grade security including PCI Level 3 compliance, SSO, and MFA.

## Key Topics

- Royalty-free stock media
- Stock audio and music collections
- Adobe Creative Cloud integration
- After Effects and Premiere Pro plugins
- DaVinci Resolve compatibility
- Storyblocks API
- Storyblocks AI Toolkit
- Maker subscription tier
- PCI Level 3 compliance
- Instrumental music collections
- Suspense and empowering music
- Enterprise security (SSO, MFA)
- Unlimited downloads
- Creative workflow tools

## Audio Collections

- [Download Royalty-Free Empowering Music Tracks - Storyblocks](https://www.storyblocks.com/audio/collections/empowering-instrumental-music): Curated collection of empowering instrumental music tracks for downloads
- [Curated Royalty Free Suspense Music - Storyblocks](https://www.storyblocks.com/audio/collections/suspense): Curated suspense music collection for video projects
- [Download Royalty-Free Cozy Music and Sound - Storyblocks](https://www.storyblocks.com/audio/collections/cozy-music): Cozy music and warm sound effects collection for creative projects
